title: onoseris paniculata
intro: Onoseris paniculata, commonly known as Mountain Onos, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help alleviate conditions like arthritis and reduce oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Onos include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, making it useful for wound healing and pain management. The bioactive constituents of Onoseris paniculata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
